item.title: India News Today – Friday, October 30, 2026
item.description: A helicopter crashed in Uttarakhand on Friday afternoon, killing all six people on board, including the pilot. The Trans Bharat Aviation helicopter was flying from Badrinath to Dehradun when it went down near Joshimath in Chamoli district amid rain and heavy cloud. Officials say it lost contact shortly after takeoff.
